[[File:Chay_Cortess.png|thumb|right|200px|Baroness Cortess of Alderaan]]
'''Baroness''' was a title of [[Noble/Legends|nobility]]. Baroness [[Sanya Tagge/Legends|Sanya Tagge]] of [[Tepasi/Legends|Tepasi]] headed the [[House of Tagge/Legends|House of Tagge]] during the [[Separatist Crisis/Legends|Separatist Crisis]] and the beginning of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], being succeeded by her son [[Orman Tagge/Legends|Orman Tagge]] as [[Baron/Legends|Baron]].<ref name="HTSWL">{{HoloNetNewsWeb|49|business/13328_1.html|House of Tagge Sides with Loyalists}}</ref>

Baroness [[Chay Cortess]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] was among that [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] leading nobles during the [[Great Galactic War]].<ref name="SWTOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> At different points of her career operating under aliases, [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] claimed to be Baroness Muehling of [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]<ref name="Balance Point">''[[The New Jedi Order: Balance Point]]''</ref> and Baroness Paltonae.<ref name="By the Emperor's Hand">''[[Star Wars: Mara Jade – By the Emperor's Hand]]''</ref> Other baronesses included Baroness [[Omnino]] of [[Vena]],<ref name="Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell">''[[Star Wars: Qui-Gon and Obi-Wan: Last Stand on Ord Mantell]]''</ref> Baroness [[Kirma Umber]],<ref name="Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows">''[[Coruscant Nights II: Street of Shadows]]''</ref> Baroness [[Mellona Gantrolo]], and Baroness [[Balmai Wyngarde]].<ref name="Lords of the Expanse">''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''</ref>
